title: Archaeology RadiocarbonSiteChronology

stats.done_summary: Completed Huangtupo radiocarbon site chronology analysis. Deliverables: (1) Analysis code in code/analyze_chronology.py calculating conventional 14C ages using Libby formula and simplified calibration; (2) Four figures in report/images/ showing age-stratigraphy relationship, calibrated timeline, F14-age conversion, and period distribution; (3) Comprehensive report in report/report.md with methodology, results tables, discussion of multi-period occupation (Late Pleistocene to Iron Age), stratigraphic analysis, and recommendations. All eight samples processed with ages ranging from ~1,000 to ~44,000 BP.
